title: The Benjamini–Schramm nonuniqueness conjecture

result.label: The Benjamini–Schramm nonuniqueness conjecture
result.statement: Proves pc pu for Bernoulli bond percolation on every infinite connected locally finite nonamenable quasi-transitive graph, resolving the Benjamini–Schramm nonuniqueness conjecture. Thus there is a nonempty range of probabilities with infinitely many infinite clusters. A stronger operator bound also establishes the critical triangle condition.
